name: bluerock
description: The tools that come with BlueRock for AI Builders. They run inside your agentic project, the repo you set up in the learning path. Ready-made agent teams turn a job into a shareable deliverable, a few questions and one run each: an Account Scorecard on a company, a Brand Messaging Doc from your own site, Competitor Battlecards, Answer Engine Visibility, Sales Outreach Prep, a Weekly Signal Digest across your accounts, and Process to Skill, which turns a process in your head into a skill you run. Onboarding learns how you write, a living list holds your daily priorities, and an end-of-day wrap-up keeps your dashboard current and points you at the next use case. Everything it writes is plain markdown in your own repo.
